note: Facets follow the single official bullet's own commas where possible. Revenue/tenure terminology, the British-commissioner sequence, coin/inscription finds, fort-location pairs, and newspaper/editor pairs were added after reading ~90 real PYQs — all five recur heavily and none is named in the bullet.
